run.change_description: Enable Flow typings on errors tests + Fix typing for Error constructor

summary.intent: Turn on `@flow strict` for the error and inspect tests and widen the `GraphQLError` constructor typing to accept `null` for `nodes` (commit message; the PR body was empty and no issue exists).
summary.issue_fit: Unavailable — no originating issue; the commit message was the intent source. Both promises are met, but one test was weakened while being retyped.
summary.coverage: Complete merge-base diff of 5 files reviewed against the base tree; local range only (no forge access, so the packet's earlier review comment on `nodes` accepting `null` was not carried as a prior item; the head adds `| null`, which matches it). Focused mocha run of the error and inspect tests at head: 27 passing. A scratch-copy mutation of the stack guard in `GraphQLError.js` was run under the work directory; the reviewed tree was not modified. One must-fix candidate was confirmed by a fresh-context verifier.

findings.title: Keep the stackless original error in the stack-fallback test
findings.trigger: Change the guard in `GraphQLError.js:195` from `if (originalError && originalError.stack)` to `if (originalError)`. The merge-base test fails with `expected undefined to be a string`; the head test still passes.
findings.impact: `creates new stack if original error has no stack` now passes `new Error('original')`, which has a stack, so it takes the same branch as the previous test. Nothing tests the `Error.captureStackTrace` fallback any more, and a GraphQLError wrapping a stackless error could end up with `stack === undefined` unnoticed.
findings.change: In `src/error/__tests__/GraphQLError-test.js`, build the stackless original explicitly: `const original: any = new Error('original'); original.stack = undefined;`, keeping the other assertions. In a scratch copy this passes on the real code and fails on the mutant.

requirements.source: commit-7e39a12/"Enable Flow typings on errors tests"
requirements.evidence: The four test files switch to `@flow strict` (`GraphQLError-test.js:9`, `locatedError-test.js:9`, `printError-test.js:9`, `inspect-test.js:9`), but the retyping changed `GraphQLError-test.js:58` so that test no longer covers the stackless-original branch (error/no-stack-test-lost-branch).
`src/error/GraphQLError.js:25` now accepts `| null` for `nodes`; the implementation at `GraphQLError.js:99-107` already treats a falsy `nodes` as absent.
